{{- /* Folder index.md pages render through single.html in Foundry → folder card page when the slug has children in the site model; otherwise the note page. */ -}} {{ define "main" }} {{- $n := partial "creator/page-node.html" . | transform.Unmarshal -}} {{- $shell := "" -}} {{- if eq $n.g 0 -}} {{- $shell = partial "creator/folder-page.html" (dict "page" . "node" $n) -}} {{- else -}} {{- $shell = partial "creator/note-page.html" (dict "page" . "node" $n) -}} {{- end -}} {{- partial "encrypt-content.html" (dict "Page" . "HTML" $shell) -}} {{ end }}
